name: transporter
notes: The array's transporter: a crawler on two 15 m wide tracks 85 m long under a 70 m by 90 m yellow deck, carrying one array dish chained to its cradle. The 7 m square cab is on the front-west corner (front is local -Z) with the engine house behind it, a 2 m wide stair on the west side climbs to the deck, and every door is 1 m by 2.25 m. Carves nothing.
